scope: Independent read-only P1 multi-AAC review; no provider requests, build or product edits.

finding.location: web-port/youtube.ts stream(), after result = await p1Stream(...) and before streams.set
finding.description: An external abort between p1Stream resolving and the stream continuation can still return and cache a locator for the aborted operation.
finding.reproducibility: Loaded the unchanged real integration harness and orchestration. Overrode only the metadata-probe dependency with an async success and a chain of four Promise microtasks before controller.abort(). Added a read-only observation hook directly before streams.set to distinguish abort before cache from cancellation after completion.
finding.proposedFix: checkAbort(signal) in stream immediately before cache cleanup/write. Keep the existing check after the asynchronous probe cleanup.
finding.caveat: Synthetic deterministic scheduling evidence, not a claim that this caused the reported Ni, Ni, Ni! fallback.
finding.status: Fixed by parent in 6a52da89c392e73df969d40250b762601d5334f1; targeted regression rejects before caching.

regression.title: abort between completed P1 cleanup and the public stream continuation cannot cache the locator
regression.negativeControl: Explicit Git pin; an earlier HEAD-based comparison was discarded because HEAD had advanced to the fix during the audit.
